article.headline: Pagotto’s 30 lead Northern Kentucky past South Dakota 102-94
article.description: — Noah Pagotto put up 30 points as Northern Kentucky beat South Dakota 102-94 on Wednesday.

article.story: VERMILLION, S.D. -- — Noah Pagotto put up 30 points as Northern Kentucky beat South Dakota 102-94 on Wednesday. Pagotto shot 11 of 15 from the field and 7 for 11 from the line for the Norse (2-0). Willie Foster scored 22 points while going 7 of 14 from the floor, including 3 for 5 from 3-point range, and 5 for 5 from the line. Eric Acker also had 22 points and shot 7 for 13 (2 for 3 from 3-point range) and 6 of 9 from the free-throw line. Jahni Summers led the Coyotes (1-1) in scoring, finishing with 24 points and two steals. South Dakota got 20 points and two steals from Vince Buzelis. Kajus Kublickas had 15 points and four assists. Up next Northern Kentucky plays Friday against Texas A&M on the road, and South Dakota hosts CSU Fullerton on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
